newsitem.title: JAPAN: RTRS-Freestyle skiing-Marshall jumps to winter sports history.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Freestyle skiing-Marshall jumps to winter sports history.

text.p: Australia's Kirstie Marshall made winter sports history on Sunday when she won the women's aerials event at the world freestyle skiing championships.

Both Marshall and Canada's Nicholas Fontaine earned the highest scores awarded in aerials competition and in winning Marshall became the first winter sports world champion from the southern hemisphere.
"I never aimed just to be the best Australian because I was the only Australian," Marshall said.
